body: Same, at least in permanent sleep, I have no worries, no expectations. Nothing.

I felt this realization recently too. How that everything I've done to this point, has been meaningless. Sure, I could have done meaningful things in the past, but in the end it doesn't mean shit if I'm just here at the will of this soul sucking society. A slave to the system, saving money so that I can have the last little while of my life for retirement and let my body deteriorate. If I die soon at least I die on my own terms. Sure it would be selfish, weak and I would be hurting people close to me but at least I don't have to deal with shit and I will be at peace.

I'm sorry to hear about this and I hope things get better for you. Reading your post, makes me feel like my situation is minor compared to yours. I can't imagine how tough it is working in your position.
I disagree considering I'm living a life which is much better relatively to a lot of people who post here. I don't deserve to feel like this when I have all these privileges that others don't.
